conditions: 6 AM- Up and at 'em, Jackson; another beautiful Tuesday is dawning here in the Tetons. Our local star is currently rising into crystal-clear skies that will provide long-distance morning panoramas from Rendezvous Mountain's lofty heights. So, make a quick trip on the tram and take in the Big One's unrivaled sights. Slowly encroaching cloudcover will provide the slight chance of a fast-passing afternoon shower or two. But the clouds won't be able to keep the temperatures from soaring, as the summit teases the 40-degree mark and Teton Village enters the low 60s. Gusty west winds will be on the rise as the clouds roll in, eventually blowing in the 5 to 30 mph neighborhood. Playing with gravitational forces and sending sparkling crystals flying can fuel a mighty passion. So, get out here now and do some super slush slashin'! -Lege
